module: Very lightweight HTTP client for a local speech transcription service (http://localhost:27872) used to recognize spoken notes during a rally recce. It exposes sending a request to cut the recording and reading the latest transcripts. The HTTP timeout is 0.5 s. Many other calls (recording start/stop, remote audio, proxy) are commented out in the code.
notes: An HTTP code other than 200 yields {ok=false, error=<code>} and an error in the log; otherwise the server's JSON response is returned as is.
The external service must be running on port 27872: without it, every call fails after the 0.5 s timeout.
On failure, client_msg is added to the response (copy of error). If the server answers 200 but with JSON lacking an ok field, resp.ok is nil and client_msg is also set.

transcribe_recording_cut.desc: Sends the recording cut request as a JSON POST to /recordings/actions/cut.

requestBody.desc: Request body, JSON-encoded (content defined by the external service).

returns.desc: Decoded server response, or {ok=false, error, client_msg} on failure.

transcribe_transcripts_get.desc: Fetches the transcripts with a GET to /transcripts/<count>.

count.desc: Number of transcripts requested (inserted in the URL).

returns.desc: Decoded server response, or {ok=false, error, client_msg} on failure.
